column1: # Ash Jenna confronts the party after Colosso; one linear scene.

column3:
I heard them cheering.
Isaac, the hero
of Colosso.{page_break}What a pity they don't
know how much you've
already lost.{end_wait}
Why are you here?\nAre you following us?{end_wait}
I wanted to see\nwhether your friends\nwere still beside you.{end_wait}
We're here because\nwe chose to be.\nWhat's it to you?{end_wait}
We trust each other.\nYou can't turn that\nagainst us.{end_wait}

Trust won't stop
a blade, Mia.{page_break}Would you still stay
if Isaac led you
into another defeat?{end_wait}
I know the risks.\nI'm still here.{end_wait}
For now.{page_break}If you stand in my way,\nI won't care which one\nof you I have to hurt.{end_wait}
Then stay away from them.\nWe've heard enough.{end_wait}
Don't turn your back\non me, Isaac.{page_break}Not when I'm still\ntalking to you.{end_wait}
Babi's errand comes first.\nBut if we return to Vale,\nwe'll ask the elders.{end_wait}
